description.en: The IP address of the node.

description.zh: 云原生ACK架构集群的节点名称，可调用[ListAllNode](~~183958~~)接口获取。
description.en: The name of the node in a cloud-native ACK-based cluster. You can call the [ListAllNode](~~183958~~) operation to obtain the node name.

description.zh:
需要缩容的节点类型，可选值：

- WORKER：热节点
- WORKER_WARM：冷节点
description.en:
The type of nodes to scale in. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node.
The access port number of the node.

description.zh: 实例节点所在的可用区ID。例如，上海可用区C为cn-shanghai-c。
description.en: The zone ID of the instance node. For example, the zone ID for Singapore Zone C is ap-southeast-1c.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotency of the request. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
缩节点数量。
><notice> 此参数仅适用于ACK架构实例，且不支持填写body中的host参数。
></notice>
description.en:
The number of nodes to remove.
><notice> This parameter applies only to ACK-based instances. When this parameter is specified, the host parameter in the request body is not supported.
></notice>.

description.zh:
是否忽略集群健康状态：

- true：忽略
- false：不忽略
description.en:
Specifies whether to ignore the cluster health status. Valid values:

- true: Ignored.
- false: Not ignored.

description.zh:
需要缩容的节点类型，可选值：

- WORKER：热节点
- WORKER_WARM：冷节点
description.en:
The type of nodes to scale in. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node.

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时请注意：
在进行集群数据节点缩容前，需要先将待缩容节点中的数据迁移到其他节点，保证待缩容节点中无数据后，再进行集群节点缩容操作。
descriptions.en:
Note the following when you invoke this operation:
Before scaling in data nodes of a cluster, perform data migration from the nodes to be removed to other nodes. After you confirm that the nodes to be removed contain no data, proceed with the scale-in operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch shrink-node --instance-id es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000 --node-type WORKER --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --ignore-status false --count 2 --biz-body hostName=es-cn-pl32xxxxxxx-data-f-1 port=9200 host=192.168.xx.xx zoneId=cn-shanghai-c nodeType=WORKER --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun elasticsearch POST /openapi/instances/es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000/actions/shrink --region cn-hangzhou --clientToken '5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000' --count 2 --nodeType WORKER --ignoreStatus false --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body [{"hostName":"es-cn-pl32xxxxxxx-data-f-1","port":9200,"host":"192.168.xx.xx","zoneId":"cn-shanghai-c","nodeType":"WORKER"}]
